description: Read the audit trail of all memory mutations. Use this — not semantic_recall — for recency questions: 'what's the latest update?', 'what changed recently?', 'what was the last thing written?', 'show me the most recent entry.' Pass last_n=1 for the single most recent mutation. semantic_recall is for topic-based search; audit_log is for time-ordered history, integrity checks, and debugging unexpected state.

last_n.description: Number of recent entries to return (default 20)

tool.description: Filter by tool name (entity_update, decision_log, memory_commit, plan_update)

name: audit_log
